plugin_desc: Huawei-specific SNMP collection for switches. In addition to standard IF-MIB interface metrics, it collects Huawei private OIDs (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB) for device health: per-entity CPU/memory (descr=entPhysicalName), temperature sensors, fan status, PSU state/presence (hwEntityPwrState / hwEntityPwrPresent), and per-module SFP optical DDM (Rx/Tx power plus temperature, voltage, and laser bias). Optical power is stored as raw µW; metrics keep module-level series (dimensions=descr) and convert to dBm in the query via 10*log10(µW/1000). Optical voltage is millivolts and converted to volts in the query. Stack/CSS member, port, and link health come from HUAWEI-STACK-MIB / HUAWEI-CSS-MIB (hwStack* and hwCss*). Huawei reports memory as a utilization percentage directly. Supported brands/models include Huawei S-series campus and chassis switches (S5700/S6700/S7700/S8700/S9300/S9700/S12700/S12700E/S16700) and CloudEngine CE series SKUs such as CE6881/CE5881.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity CPU utilization of the Huawei device control plane (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityCpuUsage), normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity memory utilization of the Huawei device (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityMemUsage), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each Huawei hardware sensor (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Huawei cooling fan (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityFanState). Huawei reports a binary state where 1 means normal and 2 means abnormal; any value other than normal indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating and should be investigated immediately.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei switch power supply (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityPwrState). A non-normal state signals a power redundancy or hardware fault; on devices with redundant PSUs a single failure may not cause an outage but removes redundancy and must be remediated promptly. Dimension descr is hwEntityPwrIndex.

metrics.name: device_psu_present
metrics.description: Presence of each Huawei switch power supply (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityPwrPresent). Absent means the slot is empty or the module was pulled; combined with PSU state this confirms lost redundancy. Dimension descr is hwEntityPwrIndex.

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical receive power in dBm (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalRxPower). The device reports µW; Telegraf stores raw µW and this query converts with 10*log10(µW/1000), dropping <=0 (invalid/no-module). Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical transmit power in dBm (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalTxPower). The device reports µW; Telegraf stores raw µW and this query converts with 10*log10(µW/1000), dropping <=0 (invalid/no-module). Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone.

metrics.name: device_optical_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature of each Huawei switch optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. High module temperature accelerates laser aging and can precede optical power failure.

metrics.name: device_optical_bias
metrics.description: Laser bias current of each Huawei switch optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalBiasCurrent). Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Drift away from the normal range is an early sign of a failing transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_voltage
metrics.description: Supply voltage of each Huawei switch optical module (HUAWEI-ENTITY-EXTENT-MIB hwEntityOpticalVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Out-of-range voltage can cause unstable optics.

metrics.name: device_stack_member_role
metrics.description: Role of each Huawei iStack / CE stack member (HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwMemberRole). Master, standby, or slave membership is the control-plane topology of the stack; unexpected role changes indicate a master switchover or a member joining/leaving.

metrics.name: device_stack_port_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei iStack / CE stack port (HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwStackPortStatus). Down means the physical stack port cannot carry stack control or forwarding, which can split the stack or force a suboptimal topology.

metrics.name: device_stack_link_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei iStack / CE stack link (HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwStackLinkStatus). A down link between members removes a stacking path and can leave the remaining members with a single point of failure.

metrics.name: device_css_member_role
metrics.description: Role of each Huawei CSS / campus-stack member (HUAWEI-CSS-MIB / HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwMemberStackRole). Chassis CSS on S12700/S9700-class devices and early campus iStack report membership here; unexpected role changes indicate a CSS master switchover.

metrics.name: device_css_port_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei CSS / early-stack port (HUAWEI-CSS-MIB / HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwStackPortStatus). Down means the CSS fabric port cannot carry cluster control or forwarding.

metrics.name: device_css_link_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei CSS / early-stack link (HUAWEI-CSS-MIB / HUAWEI-STACK-MIB hwCssLink / hwStackLink). A down CSS link between chassis splits or degrades the cluster fabric.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
